- [Is AI spying on me?](https://aipickvault.com/ai-for-beginners/is-ai-spying-on-me.html): Cloud vs local AI privacy, what companies keep, settings to turn off, local AI with Ollama.

## Local AI guides
- [Best Budget GPU for Ollama and Local LLMs (2026)](https://aipickvault.com/local-ai/best-budget-gpu-for-ollama.html): The best budget graphics cards for Ollama in 2026: RTX 3060 12GB, RTX 5060 Ti 16GB, RTX 4060 Ti 16GB and used RTX 3090, compared on VRAM, bandwidth and power.
- [Best Mini PC for Local AI and Ollama (2026)](https://aipickvault.com/local-ai/best-mini-pc-for-local-ai.html): The best mini PCs for running local AI with Ollama in 2026: Beelink SER8, GMKtec EVO-X2 and Mac mini compared on memory, bandwidth, noise and who should skip each.
- [Best Ollama Models for 16GB RAM (Windows)](https://aipickvault.com/local-ai/best-ollama-models-16gb-ram.html): Practical Ollama model picks for Windows PCs with 16GB RAM: Qwen, Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek tiers, plus what not to run and upgrade affiliate slots.
- [Budget AI PC Under $1,000](https://aipickvault.com/local-ai/budget-ai-pc-under-1000.html): Build vs buy a budget AI PC under $1000 for local chat and code help, mini PC vs DIY paths, realistic parts bands, and where RAM, SSD and used GPU money matters most.
- [How Much RAM and VRAM for Ollama? (Model Size Chart)](https://aipickvault.com/local-ai/how-much-ram-vram-for-ollama.html): RAM and VRAM needed for Ollama models from 4B to 120B: a clear size chart, the 0.6GB per billion rule, how to check ollama ps, and what to upgrade first.
- [Local AI for Windows Users](https://aipickvault.com/local-ai/): Run AI on your own Windows PC, 16GB RAM friendly, no PhD, no $5k workstation. Ollama models, install guides, and budget AI PCs from AI Pick Vault.
- [Install Ollama + Open WebUI on Windows](https://aipickvault.com/local-ai/install-ollama-open-webui-windows.html): Step-by-step Windows install for Ollama and Open WebUI, plus port conflicts, firewall, GPU drivers, and Windows Defender fixes.
